snippet.title: C64 Game: Mediator
snippet.description:
An original idea in which you mediate between flying in a spaceship and doing tasks on a planet. By the coder of Witchswitch.

Found a working ROM online for this as the other ones have a bug making level 2 uncompletable. Still too damned hard and the timer along with one avian arsehole and the irritating music drove me nuts so I ragequit.

Thanks to 8bit64k for the walkthrough footage, anyway. Info for the Atari 800 version: http://www.atarimania.com/game-atari-400-800-xl-xe-mediator_3291.html
